children: (“CBAK Energy” or the “Company”), a leading China-based lithium-ion battery manufacturer and energy solutions provider, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Jiewei Li, will present at the Sidoti Year-End Virtual Investor Conference, to be held from December 9 to December 10, 2026.

During the presentation, Mr. Li will discuss the Company's recent financial and operational performance, including developments in large cylindrical batteries, manufacturing capacity expansion, and growth in overseas markets.
Presentation Date & Time: Thursday, December 10, 2026, 8:30 a.m. – 9:00 a.m. ET

The presentation will be a live, interactive webcast followed by a Q&A session with Mr. Li. Investors are encouraged to register in advance to attend the live session and receive event updates. An archived replay will be available through the registration link following the event.

CBAK Energy ranked fourth in China for large cylindrical battery shipments during the first nine months of 2026, up from sixth in the full-year 2025 ranking, according to the Start Point Institute of Research (“SPIR”). Combined revenue from its 32140 FS and 40135 FS cells increased 152.78% year over year during the first nine months of 2026, based on unaudited financial information prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the People's Republic of China.

In October 2026, CBAK Energy announced a battery supply framework with a European technology company. Cumulative orders from the customer exceeded $4.5 million as of September 27, 2026. The Company expected annual sales from the relationship to exceed $30 million in each of 2027 and 2028.

The Company targeted an additional 6 GWh of annual production capacity at its existing Nanjing facility to meet strong demand for Model 60150 large cylindrical cells, which would bring total capacity to 10.5 GWh. Separately, it signed an investment agreement in September for a planned 12 GWh battery project in Nanjing to manufacture large cylindrical sodium-ion or lithium-ion cells.

is a China-based company that develops, manufactures and sells high-power lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries, as well as materials used in high-power lithium-ion batteries. Its battery cell production, R&D and sales operations span Nanjing, Dalian and Shangqiu, with R&D centers in Nanjing and Dalian. Its raw materials business is based in Shaoxing. The Company’s products are used in electric vehicles, light electric vehicles, energy storage systems and other high-power applications. In January 2006, CBAK Energy became the first Chinese lithium battery manufacturer to list on the Nasdaq Stock Market.

For over 25 years, Sidoti has been a provider of independent securities research focused on small- and micro-cap companies and the institutional investors that invest in their securities. Sidoti’s investor conferences have become a forum for interaction between small- and micro-cap issuers and investors.
For more information, please visit the official Sidoti Conference website.
